title: Figure 6: Insulin MEMS pump - subcutaneous drug delivery slide (Debiotech)
description: Presentation slide titled "Subcutaneous drug delivery" with a 3D cutaway rendering of a layered silicon-and-glass MEMS pump and a photograph of a small "Debiotech piezoelectric insulin pump" on a hand with a butterfly. Bullet points list features such as "Precise control of nL volumes" and "Small size: 1/4th the size of existing monitors," plus diabetes statistics; sources cited as Debiotech website and Advanced Packaging. The caption reads "Figure 6. An Insulin MEMS Pump. An implantable drug-delivery device."
